scope: Composition and primitive Clifford+T words preserve the exact basis action and resource bounds. A Toffoli is expanded into fifteen local gates.
A toggle through borrowed binary registers has a computable change in its final control predicate. Running the chain in reverse restores every temporary register.
The borrowed-wire ladder realizes a many-controlled NOT using linear-size local gate words, following Lemma 7.2.

The balanced split of Barenco et al., Lemma 7.3 and Corollary 7.4, implements a k-controlled NOT with one borrowed qubit and at most 120(k+3) addressed one- and two-qubit gates. The matrix action includes arbitrary superpositions and restores the borrowed wire.
The two-qubit controlled NOT realizes its classical action on every computational basis ket.
